verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm, but it runs a software-supported unit (ySolutions) and says it uses legal tech and AI-based systems. A machine-access interface such as an MCP server is therefore conceivable, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an official MCP server, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI endpoints all returned 404, so there is no evidence of any agent-facing interface.
